hints: The centre is $(-2, 3)$ and radius is $r = 5$.
Leftmost point is $(-2 - 5, 3) = (-7, 3)$ and rightmost point is $(-2 + 5, 3) = (3, 3)$.
walkthrough:
Horizontal extreme points lie one radius either side of the centre.
Complete the square to find centre and radius:
$$(x + 2)^2 - 4 + (y - 3)^2 - 9 - 12 = 0$$
$$(x + 2)^2 + (y - 3)^2 = 25$$
$$\text{Centre } = (-2, 3), \quad r = 5$$

Calculate the leftmost and rightmost coordinates by shifting along the horizontal axis:
$$\text{Leftmost point: } (-2 - 5, 3) = (-7, 3)$$
$$\text{Rightmost point: } (-2 + 5, 3) = (3, 3)$$
